intro.text: Shade-haunted forests where any journey is perilous, above all after dark.

description.text: Shades, deadly spirits whose single touch can make a person into another shade, roam the trees. People keep to the Simple Rules in the belief that these let them avoid the shades.

Many people shelter inside forts. Fortfolk stand out by their dress, such as tall broad-brimmed hats or long black coats with lace down the front, and few of those who leave the forts, merchants included, know how to last long outside. The forts tax forest dwellers, who often dodge payment by vanishing into the trees, so the forts offer silver bounties to hunters who bring such people in.
Neutral waystops give travellers a safe place to rest, and a number of homesteads have also been set up among the trees.
Fugitives often hide in the forests under false names. Anyone who lasts there is hardy and self-sufficient; the weak or careless are usually dead within weeks.
